title: Recraft Style
description: A custom Recraft style created from one to five reference images. Custom styles are compatible with V3 models and can be passed via `style_id` on generation requests.

id.description: Style identifier. Use as `style_id` in generation requests.

base_style.description: Base style group the custom style was registered under (e.g. `digital_illustration`).

model.description: Recraft model the style is bound to.

credits.description: API units charged for style creation (40 units / $0.04 at time of writing).

reference_images.description: Reference image identifiers uploaded to mint the style.

created.description: Unix epoch timestamp when the style was created.
